# New Life Mwangaza Rehabilitation Center (NLMRC)

> New Life Mwangaza Rehabilitation Center (NLMRC) is a non-profit organization dedicated to transforming the lives of street-connected children through rescue, rehabilitation, and reintegration programs.

This file provides Language Models with an overview and directory of key information about NLMRC's mission, impact, and services.

## Main Pages

- [Home](https://www.newlifemwangaza.org/): The main landing page with an overview of our mission and impact.
- [About Us](https://www.newlifemwangaza.org/about/story): History, mission, vision, and team members.
- [Services](https://www.newlifemwangaza.org/services): Detailed information about our core programs including education, shelter, rescue, and rehabilitation.
- [Impact](https://www.newlifemwangaza.org/impact): Statistics and information on how we transform lives.
- [Stories](https://www.newlifemwangaza.org/stories): Success stories and testimonies from the children we support.
- [Donate](https://www.newlifemwangaza.org/donate): Information on how to support NLMRC financially, including monthly sponsorship and custom donation options.
- [Volunteer](https://www.newlifemwangaza.org/volunteer): Opportunities to join us and volunteer your time.
- [Careers](https://www.newlifemwangaza.org/career): Current job openings at NLMRC.
- [Contact](https://www.newlifemwangaza.org/contact): Contact information and inquiry forms.

## Optional

- [Reports](https://www.newlifemwangaza.org/about/reports): Annual reports, financial summaries, and strategic plans.
- [Newsletters](https://www.newlifemwangaza.org/impact/newsletters): Our regular newsletters with updates on our activities.
- [Gallery](https://www.newlifemwangaza.org/gallery): Photos of our center and activities.
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.newlifemwangaza.org/privacy-policy): How we handle data and privacy.
- [Terms of Service](https://www.newlifemwangaza.org/terms): Terms and conditions for using our website.
- [Disclaimer](https://www.newlifemwangaza.org/disclaimer): Legal disclaimers.
